findings_and_questions.classification: current corroboration and bounded receiver refinement of existing 059 question; no automatic duplicate count
findings_and_questions.first_contract: CityGate::door ORs the CityPropertyId bits into the fixed 0xc300000000000000 opening tag and owns_opening recognizes any opening with those tag bits. Property IDs 1 and (1 | 1<<56) are distinct u64 values but yield the same tagged opening word because bit 56 is already set in the tag. An ordinary SceneDoor with an opening ID satisfying the mask follows the gate presentation branch: it does not receive the PresentedBuildingClosureMesh or building LOD visibility components used by the shown sync system.
findings_and_questions.condition_and_limits: The public property wrapper and SceneDoor decoder do not themselves prove reserved-bit constraints or namespace membership, but a supported admitted high-bit property pair or an ordinary tagged opening reaching this receiver was not established. The independently traced normal CitySite generated roster takes at most 16,384 lots and assigns IDs 1..=16,384, and property compilation copies lot.id; this shown generator path avoids that property-bit collision. Actual external/other producers, ordinary opening ID bounds, scene admission, and visible impact remain unproved. No runtime, fixture, or product validation.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Trace every admitted property and ordinary opening producer and keyed consumer; establish a disjoint/injective identity contract or contextual tagged identity at the proper boundary if their domains require it. Preserve small generated IDs and gate-specific visibility semantics.
relationships: Exact historical 059 L12-CLOSURE-CITY-GATE-OPENING-ID-DOMAIN raised this first operation and reserved-bit question; the current roster and actual presentation receiver narrow it without rewriting historic scope or claiming closure.
Related to P16-COLLISION-BAR-SOURCE-IDENTITY and the roof child packed-ID domain only as namespace patterns; no alias or shared accepted duplicate is assumed.

findings_and_questions.classification: conditional public aggregate admission question from distinct current entry points
findings_and_questions.first_contract: CityGate has public raw width and height. For a finite gate with width 0, positive height and finite admitted orientation/centre, fixed_members can construct the two positive-width gate posts without checking that opening width is positive; CityGate::door separately passes width to LeafDimensions and returns ZeroExtent. Thus the fixed-member operation alone does not establish that the same descriptor can produce an operable leaf.
findings_and_questions.condition_and_limits: A caller must provide a zero-width or otherwise invalid public/decoded gate to a consumer of fixed members without validating the separate door. The shown ordinary property producer supplies a 1.6 m width, and the packing clearance shown calls gate.door after fixed members. Terrain projection invokes fixed_members independently, but no successful accepted malformed compound/foundation or wrong rendered geometry is established. Zero-valid generic cuboid extents are a distinct intentional contract.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Determine the accepted boundary for the whole CityGate and whether fixed geometry is intentionally valid without an operable leaf. If a complete gate requires a positive aperture, admit or validate that contract at the actual shared boundary while preserving contextual errors and generic zero-extent cuboids.
relationships: Connected to 059 gate/door/aggregate owner and support questions, but not the same demonstrated operation as reserved-bit encoding, right-hinge placement, or terrain datum dispatch. Central adjudicates any count.

lenses.bounded_assessment: Boundary errors carry BoundarySupportElement and GeometryError, while serde tags map typed enums; no domain decision based on diagnostic prose was found in assigned bodies.

Gate dimensions, tag mask, wall-cap and spacing constants are named. Domain mask is a semantic namespace contract, distinct from physical metres, fixed mathematical quarter-turn and sampling tolerances.

CityPropertyId, OpeningAssemblyId, SceneBuildingId and ResolvedItemId remain distinct roles. Existing PlanDirection/Position/LeafDimensions and explicit GroundRelative/GateRelative payloads already own admitted output semantics.

Public CityGate retains centre and dimensions as raw values until creating typed positions/dimensions; correct checked owners and admission policy must be chosen at an actual supported boundary rather than presumed from common float width.

PropertySide owns signed local handedness and BoundarySupportElement retains wall/cap/post identity. Domain tags, property IDs and presentation leaf classifications remain distinct; named physical constraints should not collapse the separate frame datums.

Door creation computes a hinge, signed quarter turn and leaf dimensions with contextual errors; fixed_members calculates wall midpoint/distance and post positions, accepting zero-width gate before leaf admission. Geometry overflow and valid range remain qualified.

CityCompound associates front/rear IDs, plot, court, access and boundary without visible whole-record validation in the type itself. BoundaryOwnerBinding and terrain projection perform some owner/member checks, not a complete accepted-graph proof.

Public serde CityGate and CityBoundary fields allow independent values before operation. LeafDimensions rejects zero/negative/nonfinite; fixed posts validate their own finite positions and cuboid extents. Admission boundaries may intentionally differ and need caller proof.

PropertySide and CityBoundaryPose represent distinct roles with appropriate associated centre frame. Local `cap` selection uses a temporary bool to build the owning enum, not automatically a persistent semantic boolean defect.

Gate raw descriptor and projected DoorSpec are independently represented at different derivation stages; property/front/rear references and support binding/digest require producer/consumer consistency rather than assuming duplication by common value.

P16 and current individual objects match, but the whole dirty patch is missing. Preserve zero-datum packing, soil/gate terrain dispatch, left/right signed sweep, typed error element/source and ordinary 1.6 m gate behavior.

CityGate::door calculates new positions/directions and admits checked leaves; 774 TRACE-001 explicitly recognized these as new computations, not already checked values lost. Typed CityPropertyId is encoded to a distinct opening authority whose domain remains unresolved.

Serde derives for public raw descriptors are not proof of aggregate admission. BoundaryGeometryError retains typed source and element; no derive substitution is supported without preserving context and actual modes.
